title: Treatise of the Living Fold
summary: A treatise on joining the space stream to the life stream so folds of space seed and mend living bodies.

title: Canon of the Absent Fold
summary: A canon of joining the space stream to the void stream until the fold itself is emptied and nothing remains in it.

title: Treatise of the Folded Moment
summary: A treatise on joining the space stream to the time stream so a fold of distance also folds the span of an instant.
